summary: We can do the #femhack program on a shoestring. @IndieWebCamp usually under <500 and that covers meals for everyone., but want to connect with top developers who understand how to mentor. Any support from #nhv #edtechchat #ctedu #cs4all can go long way in CT

body_html:

Any support from #nhv #edtechchat #ctedu #cs4all can go long way in CT
